items.title: Clara Mae Arnold Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: The name 'Clown' appears only as a transcription error or mishearing of the interviewee's name 'Clara Mae Arnold' by the interviewer. There is no mention of a person named Clown in the transcript.

ctx.x: The New York Times Your name please?
Would you mind repeating that? Clown, New Orleans. How old are you? Thirteen. When were you born as well?
